description: Render the last recording to a GIF or MP4 file, frame by frame from the app (needs captureScreen). MP4 needs ffmpeg on the PATH; GIF does not.

path.description: Output file. Default keyframer-<time>.<format> in the project.

touches.description: Draw where the fingers were (default true when the recording has touches).

width.description: Pixels, default 390 for GIF and 720 for MP4.

name: export_recording
